#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    long long x, y, n;
    scanf("%lld %lld %lld", &x, &y, &n);
    
    double target = (double)x / y;
    
    long long best_a = 0, best_b = 1;
    double min_diff = 1e18;
    
    for (long long b = 1; b <= n; b++) {
        // Find the best a for this denominator b
        long long a = (long long)round(target * b);
        
        // Check floor and ceil to be safe
        vector<long long> candidates;
        candidates.push_back(max(0LL, (long long)floor(target * b)));
        candidates.push_back((long long)ceil(target * b));
        
        for (long long cand : candidates) {
            double diff = fabs((double)cand / b - target);
            if (diff < min_diff - 1e-12 || 
                (fabs(diff - min_diff) < 1e-12 && b < best_b) ||
                (fabs(diff - min_diff) < 1e-12 && b == best_b && cand < best_a)) {
                min_diff = diff;
                best_a = cand;
                best_b = b;
            }
        }
    }
    
    printf("%lld/%lld\n", best_a, best_b);
    return 0;
}
